evidence_quotes:
USAGE: Transmission
(4L80-E)
FLUID/LUBRICANT: Dexron
® III only
(Do not use Dexron® II)
CAPACITIES: Dry: 13.5 qt (12.8L)
Drain & Refill 7.7 qt (7.3 L)
EXPECTED TEMPERATURE: All Temperatures
Except Arctic
statements.reason: The lubrication table specifies Dexron® III only and expressly excludes Dexron® II outside arctic conditions.
statements.statement: In non-arctic service, only Dexron® III is allowed in the 4L80-E transmission; Dexron® II may not be used.

evidence_quotes:
USAGE: Transmission
(4L80-E)
FLUID/LUBRICANT: Dexron
® III only
(Do not use Dexron® II)
CAPACITIES: Dry: 13.5 qt (12.8L)
Drain & Refill 7.7 qt (7.3 L)
EXPECTED TEMPERATURE: All Temperatures
Except Arctic

Failure to use only Dexron® III for
4L80E transmission will cause damage
to transmission.
statements.reason: The manual excludes Dexron® II and warns that failure to use only Dexron® III will damage the transmission.
statements.statement: In non-arctic service, using Dexron® II in the 4L80-E transmission will damage it.

evidence_quotes:
Use Dexron® II for filling transfer case.
Failure to use Dexron® II will cause
damage to transfer case.

USAGE: Transfer (218)
Case
FLUID/LUBRICANT: Dexron® II
or Dexron® III
CAPACITIES: 3.5 qt (3.3 L)
EXPECTED TEMPERATURE: All Temperatures

USAGE: Transfer
Case       (242)
FLUID/LUBRICANT: Dexron® II
or Dexron® III
CAPACITIES: 3.35 qt (3.17 L)
EXPECTED TEMPERATURE: All Temperatures
statements.reason: The transfer-case filling instruction specifies Dexron® II without a transmission-type restriction; both listed transfer-case models also allow it at all temperatures.
statements.statement: In non-arctic service, Dexron® II can be used to fill the transfer case regardless of transmission type.

statements.reason: 3.5 qt is a listed capacity, not the level criterion. On level ground, the level should be within 1/2 in. of the fill-plug opening.
statements.statement: In non-arctic service, on level ground, the stated transfer-case level criterion for model 218 is a fill of 3.5 quarts (3.3 L).

statements.reason: 3.35 qt is a listed capacity, not the level criterion. On level ground, the level should be within 1/2 in. of the fill-plug opening.
statements.statement: In non-arctic service, on level ground, the stated transfer-case level criterion for model 242 is a fill of 3.35 quarts (3.17 L).
